description: This file contains functions and type definitions for managing and resolving Matrix runtime clients, including loading dependencies, ensuring client readiness, and handling client lifecycle (start, stop, cleanup).

methods.name: loadMatrixSharedClientRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Loads shared dependencies for Matrix client runtime, caching the promise.

methods.name: ensureResolvedClientReadiness
methods.description: Ensures the Matrix client is in the desired readiness state (started or prepared).

methods.name: ensureMatrixNodeRuntime
methods.description: Checks if the runtime is Node (bun runtime not supported) and throws an error if not.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeMatrixClient
methods.description: Resolves and returns a Matrix runtime client, either from provided client, active client, or by creating a new shared client.
